2026_02_MIN_CHI.headline: Chicago’s explosive opener meets Minnesota’s Soldier Field streak
2026_02_MIN_CHI.paragraph1: Chicago comes home after an explosive season-opening win in Carolina, where its offense piled up production on the ground and through Caleb Williams. Minnesota arrives unbeaten too, and the Vikings’ schedule preview notes that they have won six straight at Soldier Field. That gives this division game a useful tension: the Bears want to keep their balanced offense rolling, while Minnesota needs to disrupt early downs and prevent Chicago from reaching the favorable situations that made the opener snowball.
2026_02_MIN_CHI.model_rationale: Chicago’s early-down balance against Minnesota’s defense determines whether the Bears can stay multiple or the Vikings can turn a familiar road setting into another controlled division game.
